about: SQL statements, per dialect, that a formatter must leave unchanged in meaning: hazards are strings and names holding keywords, comment markers and semicolons, operators made of several characters, casts, dollar quotes, escapes, placeholders, variables, comments in odd places. Used by tests/unit/sqlfmt.test.mjs (tokens kept) and tests/e2e/sqlfmt.e2e.mjs (sqlglot parses the original and the formatted text to the same tree; SQLite runs both with the same result). Own work.
